title: 第3章 大乡里出城第4章 摆摊少年
content_zh:
自那天拳打无良鉴宝大叔的事件后，白月在云风面前就开始有点嘚瑟。
原因就是白月从那胖大叔的嘴里套出了话，那两个碗竟真的是真品！而且还与她脑海中出现的名词完全吻合！
白色的碗是明成化的青花缠枝秋葵纹碗，而红色的其实不是碗，而是一个盘，清代的青花釉里红鱼纹盘。
白月将她有可能身怀鉴宝异能的想法透露给云风后，本想看看他惊讶的表情。
谁知道他面上竟是波澜不惊，仿佛早就知道她会有异能一般，弄得白月很是无趣。
“你呀，占了便宜还卖乖。”
云风宠溺的用手指戳了戳白月的小脑门。
“多少人想要你这样的能力都不得，我也只是自小跟着我干爷爷才知道一些这方面的知识。”
看着眼前卖乖的小女孩，那一张纯真洁白的脸蛋，云风看着心里直痒痒，又想着怎么开始蹂躏她的小脑袋。
白月歪了歪小脑袋，大大的眼睛眨巴着，一张小脸充满疑惑的表情，一头蓬松的头发就像是毛茸茸的小动物，看得云风差点鼻血都流了下来，这世间怎么会有这样的萌物！
“听你这么一说，你二爷爷倒是个古玩收藏家咯？”
“嗯，也算是。”
说起二爷爷，云风抬起头，云风不禁抬头望向窗外，看着窗外的白云，似是想起了过往种种，脸上浮现出了一抹怀念之色。
“我从小就喜欢跟着二爷爷，他家里藏品很多，样样都是精品。”
“哦？样样都是精品，那你二爷爷一定很有钱，什么时候也带我开开眼？”
一说到钱，白月就来了精神，蹭一下双手就撑在桌子上，眼睛直勾勾的盯着云风，眼里开始冒光。
一看到这丫头见钱眼开的模样，云风不禁想笑。
“你这丫头，莫不是穷怕了？人都掉到钱眼里去了，有机会的话还是可以去见上一见的，就是不知道还有没有机会了...”
想到此处，云风的眼神里便开始失了神采，变得有些沮丧。
“好了，先不说这个，这不是还要仰仗白大小姐的眼力，鉴鉴之前我们捡漏淘下的真品，到时候好卖钱带你去吃香喝辣。”

说着趁白月不注意又开始蹂躏起她可爱的小脑袋。
“来来来，让我看看。”
白月这时也来了兴致，看向了云风在桌上放好的一个个物件。
把手放在物件的表面上进行感应。
“唔...明永乐的青花花卉纹八方烛台..北宋汝窑莲花碗...看起来都很值钱的样子啊！”
看着这丫头明明盯着一堆古玩，眼里却像是看到了一大堆钱一样。
明明是一堆具有欣赏珍藏价值的文物，到这丫头眼里就只看到钱，若是让他家干爷爷看到这些他巴不得都藏起来的古玩，却被一个小丫头当商品一样论价，非得气死不可。
“好了，差不多是时候了，明天我们连同之前淘的东西一并带上，我们坐车去市里把东西变现可好？”
云风真的是被这个小财迷击倒了，嘴角微微抽搐着，便开始收拾东西。
“咦？”
content_en:
Ever since that day when she punched the unscrupulous treasure appraiser, Bai Yue started to feel a little shy in front of Yun Feng.
The reason was that Bai Yue got the words out of the fat uncle's mouth, and those two bowls were really genuine! And it completely matched the noun that appeared in her mind!
The white bowl is a bowl with blue and white branches and okra patterns from the Ming Dynasty, while the red one is actually not a bowl, but a plate, a blue and white underglaze red fish pattern plate from the Qing Dynasty.
After Bai Yue revealed to Yunfeng the idea that she might have the ability to detect treasures, she wanted to see his surprised expression.
Who knew that his face was actually calm, as if he had already known that she would have special powers, which made Bai Yue very boring.
"You, you took advantage and acted like a good boy."
Yunfeng fondly poked Bai Yue's forehead with his finger.
"No matter how many people want to have abilities like yours, I only know some knowledge in this area after following my grandpa since I was a child."
Looking at the innocent little girl in front of him, Yunfeng felt itchy in his heart, and thought about how to start ravaging her little head.
Bai Yue tilted her little head, her big eyes blinked, her little face was full of doubts, and her fluffy hair looked like a furry animal. Yunfeng almost had a nosebleed when she looked at it. How could there be such a cute creature in this world!
"From what you said, your second grandfather is actually an antique collector?"
"Yeah, that's right."
Speaking of the second grandfather, Yunfeng raised his head. Yunfeng couldn't help but look up and looked out the window. Looking at the white clouds outside the window, he seemed to remember all the past, and a look of nostalgia appeared on his face.
"I have loved following my second grandfather since I was a child. He has a lot of collections at home, and everything is of high quality."
"Oh? Everything is of high quality, so your second grandfather must be very rich. When will you show me some eyes?"
When it came to money, Bai Yue became energetic. She put her hands on the table and stared at Yunfeng, her eyes starting to shine.
Yunfeng couldn't help but want to laugh when he saw the girl's eyes widening when she saw the money.
"Girl, are you afraid of being poor? People have fallen in love with money. If you have a chance, you can still go and meet them, but I don't know if there is another chance..."
Thinking of this, Yunfeng's eyes began to lose their luster and became a little depressed.
"Okay, let's not talk about it for now. We still have to rely on Miss Bai's eyesight. Before the appraisal, we picked up the genuine products that we missed, so that we can sell them for money and take you to eat and drink."
As he said this, he took advantage of Bai Yue's inattention and began to ravage her cute little head.
"Come on, let me see."
Bai Yue also became interested at this time and looked at the objects placed on the table by Yun Feng.
Place your hand on the surface of the object to sense it.
"Hmm... the blue and white eight-way candlestick with floral patterns from Ming Dynasty Yongle... the lotus bowl from Ru Kiln in the Northern Song Dynasty... they all look very valuable!"
Seeing this girl clearly staring at a pile of antiques, her eyes seemed to be seeing a lot of money.
They are obviously a bunch of cultural relics with appreciation and collection value, but all she sees in this girl's eyes is money. If her godfather were to see these antiques that he wished he had hidden, but were priced by a little girl as if they were commodities, he would be very angry.
"Okay, it's almost time. Let's take the things we bought tomorrow with us. How about we take the car to the city and cash in the things?"
Yunfeng was really knocked down by this little money fan. The corner of his mouth twitched slightly and he started to pack his things.
"Huh?"
